skill_name: Rewrite the given story in a different style, such as formal or humorous.
workflow: Alex had put in a great deal of effort into his math exam preparations, believing he had put forth an ample effort. However, as the questions began piling up before him, his nerves and doubts mounted. He was sure of failure - an eventuality he dreaded - but he still kept on trying, mouth set in a grim line. It was a feat of determination and grit.
